items.title: Joseph 'One Eyed Babe' Phillips Interview, 1957-03-27
items.q: I played with him. Willie Foster, Celestine.

ctx.x: Oh, yeah. I met him down here. He came down. His mother was sick. He came down to... See, and he was playing with a Papa Salas fans band. Oh, yeah. They call him Pops Foster too. Foster. Willie Foster's his brother used to get to all that.
Well, they used to work on the boat. That's right. Did you ever hear any of the fans on the boats when they came by?
